intro.en: A reading about solar, mechanical, electrical and heat energy. Read slowly and notice how each type is explained with a use.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum taqat (energy) ki qismon ke baare mein parhenge: shamsi, mekaniki, bijli aur hararat wali taqat. Har qism ke saath uska istemal bhi bataya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الطّاقَةِ الشَّمْسِيَّةِ وَالمِيكانيكِيَّةِ وَالكَهْرَبائِيَّةِ وَالحَرارِيَّةِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى شَرْحِ كُلِّ نَوْعٍ مَعَ اسْتِعْمالِهِ.

dialogue.ar: الطّاقَةُ مِنْ أَهَمِّ مُقَوِّماتِ الحَياةِ عَلى الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭāqatu min ahammi muqawwimāti l-ḥayāti ʿala l-arḍ
dialogue.en: Energy is one of the most important foundations of life on Earth.
dialogue.ur: Taqat zameen par zindagi ki sab se ahem buniyadon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: الطّاقَةُ الشَّمْسِيَّةُ: الشَّمْسُ مَصْدَرُ طاقَةٍ لا يَنْتَهي إلّا بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭāqatu sh-shamsiyya: ash-shamsu maṣdaru ṭāqatin lā yantahī illā bi-idhni llāh
dialogue.en: Solar energy: the sun is a source of energy that only ends by Allah's permission.
dialogue.ur: Shamsi taqat: suraj taqat ka woh sarchashma hai jo sirf Allah ke hukm se khatam hota hai.

dialogue.ar: هِيَ الَّتي تَمُدُّ الأَرْضَ بِالضَّوْءِ وَالحَرارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hiya llatī tamuddu l-arḍa bi-ḍ-ḍawʾi wa l-ḥarāra
dialogue.en: It gives the earth light and heat.
dialogue.ur: Yeh zameen ko roshni aur hararat deti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَحْتاجُ النَّباتاتُ إلى ضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ.
dialogue.tr: wa taḥtāju n-nabātātu ilā ḍawʾi sh-shams
dialogue.en: Plants need sunlight.
dialogue.ur: Paudhon ko dhoop ki roshni ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ أَجْهِزَةٌ تُوضَعُ عَلى سُطوحِ المَنازِلِ تَمْتَصُّ أَشِعَّةَ الشَّمْسِ وَتُحَوِّلُها إلى حَرارَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka ajhizatun tūḍaʿu ʿalā suṭūḥi l-manāzil tamtaṣṣu ashiʿʿata sh-shams wa tuḥawwiluhā ilā ḥarāra
dialogue.en: There are devices placed on house roofs that absorb the sun's rays and turn them into heat.
dialogue.ur: Ghar ki chhaton par aise aale rakhe jate hain jo suraj ki kirnein jazb karke hararat mein badal dete hain.

dialogue.ar: الطّاقَةُ المِيكانيكِيَّةُ تَحْدُثُ بِسَبَبِ حَرَكَةِ الجِسْمِ، كَالرِّياحِ الشَّديدَةِ وَالمِياهِ الجارِيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭāqatu l-mīkānīkiyya taḥduthu bi-sababi ḥarakati l-jism, ka-r-riyāḥi sh-shadīda wa l-miyāhi l-jāriya
dialogue.en: Mechanical energy comes from the movement of a body, like strong winds and running water.
dialogue.ur: Mekaniki taqat jism ki harkat se paida hoti hai, jaise tez hawayein aur behta pani.

dialogue.ar: اسْتَخْدَمَ الإِنْسانُ طاقَةَ الرِّياحِ مُنْذُ القِدَمِ لِتَسْييرِ السُّفُنِ الشِّراعِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: istakhdama l-insānu ṭāqata r-riyāḥi mundhu l-qidam li-tasyīri s-sufuni sh-shirāʿiyya
dialogue.en: Man has used wind energy since ancient times to move sailing ships.
dialogue.ur: Insan qadeem zamane se hawa ki taqat se baadbani kashtiyan chalata aaya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ لِلطّاقَةِ لا يُلَوِّثُ البيئَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya maṣdarun naẓīfun li-ṭ-ṭāqati lā yulawwithu l-bī'a
dialogue.en: It is a clean source of energy that does not pollute the environment.
dialogue.ur: Yeh taqat ka saaf sarchashma hai jo mahaul ko ganda nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: الطّاقَةُ الكَهْرَبائِيَّةُ مِنْ أَهَمِّ أَشْكالِ الطّاقَةِ، وَنَسْتَخْدِمُها في المَنازِلِ وَالمَصانِعِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭāqatu l-kahrabā'iyya min ahammi ashkāli ṭ-ṭāqa, wa nastakhdimuhā fi l-manāzili wa l-maṣāniʿ
dialogue.en: Electrical energy is one of the most important forms of energy; we use it in homes and factories.
dialogue.ur: Bijli ki taqat taqat ki ahem tareen shaklon mein se hai; hum ise gharon aur karkhanon mein istemal karte hain.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَهَمِّ مَيزاتِها سُهولَةُ نَقْلِها بِالأَسْلاكِ إلى أَماكِنَ بَعيدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: min ahammi mayzātihā suhūlatu naqlihā bi-l-aslāk ilā amākina baʿīda
dialogue.en: One of its best features is how easily it is carried by wires to far places.
dialogue.ur: Iski ahem khoobi yeh hai ke taaron ke zariye door jagahon tak aasani se pahunch jati hai.

dialogue.ar: عِنْدَما تَجْري المِياهُ مِنْ مَكانٍ مُرْتَفِعٍ إلى مَكانٍ مُنْخَفِضٍ تَنْتُجُ طاقَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿindamā tajrī l-miyāhu min makānin murtafiʿin ilā makānin munkhafiḍ tantuju ṭāqa
dialogue.en: When water flows from a high place to a low place, energy is produced.
dialogue.ur: Jab pani oonchi jagah se neechi jagah behta hai to taqat paida hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: الطّاقَةُ الحَرارِيَّةُ تَنْتُجُ مِنْ حَرْقِ الوَقودِ أَوْ مِنَ الاحْتِكاكِ بَيْنَ الأَجْسامِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭāqatu l-ḥarāriyya tantuju min ḥarqi l-waqūd aw mina l-iḥtikāki bayna l-ajsām
dialogue.en: Heat energy comes from burning fuel or from friction between objects.
dialogue.ur: Hararati taqat eendhan jalane ya cheezon ke aapas mein ragadne se paida hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ ضَرورِيَّةٌ لِلطَّبْخِ وَالتَّسْخينِ وَالتَّدْفِئَةِ في المَنازِلِ.
dialogue.tr: wa hiya ḍarūriyyatun li-ṭ-ṭabkh wa t-taskhīn wa t-tadfi'a fi l-manāzil
dialogue.en: It is needed for cooking, heating and warming homes.
dialogue.ur: Yeh gharon mein pakane, garam karne aur garmaish ke liye zaroori hai.

q.en: Which source gives the earth light and heat?
q.ur: Zameen ko roshni aur hararat kaun deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَصْدَرٍ يُعْطي الأَرْضَ الضَّوْءَ وَالحَرارَةَ؟

q.en: What does «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» mean about wind energy?
q.ur: «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» ka matlab hawa ki taqat ke liye?
q.ar: ماذا تَعْني عِبارَةُ «مَصْدَرٌ نَظيفٌ» عَنْ طاقَةِ الرِّياحِ؟

q.en: Which energy is easy to carry by wires?
q.ur: Taaron se aasani se kaun si taqat pahunchti hai?
Hararati taqat kis ke liye zaroori hai?

title.en: Grammar A: Nouns in the genitive (majrūr)

intro.en: A noun is majrūr (ends with kasra) when it comes after a preposition, when it is the second part of an idāfa, or when it follows a majrūr noun as a describing or replacing word. Example: فِي تَقَدُّمٍ - in progress (تَقَدُّمٍ comes after فِي).
intro.ur: Ism majroor (kasra par khatam) tab hota hai jab woh harf-e-jar ke baad aaye, mudaf ilayh ho, ya kisi majroor ism ka tabi ho (sifat, badal wagaira). Misal: فِي تَقَدُّمٍ - taraqqi mein (تَقَدُّمٍ, فِي ke baad).
intro.ar: يَكونُ الِاسْمُ مَجْروراً (آخِرُهُ كَسْرَةٌ) إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ حَرْفِ جَرٍّ، أَوْ كانَ المُضافَ إِلَيْهِ، أَوْ كانَ تابِعاً لِاسْمٍ مَجْرورٍ كَالصِّفَةِ أَوِ البَدَلِ. مِثالٌ: «في تَقَدُّمٍ»؛ فَكَلِمَةُ «تَقَدُّمٍ» جاءَتْ بَعْدَ «في».

q.en: A noun after a preposition is:
q.ur: Harf-e-jar ke baad ism hota hai:

q.en: What sign does a majrūr noun usually carry?
q.ur: Majroor ism par aam taur par kaun si alamat hoti hai?

intro.en: Listen to a text about water, then mark each statement true or false. Here are the statements as written, to read and think about.
intro.ur: Pani ke baare mein ek matan suniye, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat nishan lagaiye. Neeche jumle likhe hain, parh kar soochiye.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنِ الماءِ، ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. هذِهِ الجُمَلُ مَكْتوبَةٌ لِتَقْرَأَها وَتُفَكِّرَ فيها.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ أَكْثَرُ مادَّةٍ مُتَوافِرَةٍ عَلى الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: al-mā'u aktharu māddatin mutawāfiratin ʿala l-arḍ
dialogue.en: Water is the most available substance on earth.
dialogue.ur: Pani zameen par sab se zyada maujood cheez hai.

dialogue.ar: لا يوجَدُ ماءٌ في الهَواءِ.
dialogue.tr: lā yūjadu mā'un fi l-hawā'
dialogue.en: There is no water in the air.
dialogue.ur: Hawa mein pani maujood nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ في الماضي أَكْثَرُ أَهَمِّيَّةً مِنْهُ اليَوْمَ.
dialogue.tr: al-mā'u fi l-māḍī aktharu ahammiyyatan minhu l-yawm
dialogue.en: Water in the past was more important than today.
dialogue.ur: Pani guzishta zamane mein aaj se zyada ahem tha.

dialogue.ar: الماءُ نِعْمَةٌ وَقَدْ يَكونُ نِقْمَةً.
dialogue.tr: al-mā'u niʿma wa qad yakūnu niqma
dialogue.en: Water is a blessing and may be a punishment.
dialogue.ur: Pani ek naimat hai aur kabhi azab bhi ban sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: قامَتِ الحَضاراتُ القَديمَةُ عِنْدَ مَصادِرِ المِياهِ.
dialogue.tr: qāmati l-ḥaḍārātu l-qadīma ʿinda maṣādiri l-miyāh
dialogue.en: Ancient civilizations arose near water sources.
dialogue.ur: Qadeem tehzeebein pani ke sarchashmon ke paas qaim huin.

dialogue.ar: أَكْثَرُ المِياهِ المُتَوافِرَةِ صالِحَةٌ لِلشُّرْبِ.
dialogue.tr: akthāru l-miyāhi l-mutawāfira ṣāliḥatun li-sh-shurb
dialogue.en: Most of the available water is fit for drinking.
dialogue.ur: Maujood pani ka zyada hissa peene ke laaiq hai.

dialogue.ar: لا تَكْفي المِياهُ جَميعَ سُكّانِ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: lā takfī l-miyāhu jamīʿa sukkāni l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: The water does not suffice all the people of the world.
dialogue.ur: Pani dunya ke tamam baashindon ke liye kaafi nahin.

dialogue.ar: البِلادُ الفَقيرَةُ قَليلَةُ المِياهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-bilādu l-faqīratu qalīlatu l-miyāh
dialogue.en: Poor countries have little water.
dialogue.ur: Gareeb mulkon mein pani kam hota hai.

options_ar: ما يُنْعِمُ اللهُ بِهِ عَلى عِبادِهِ

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (2): Pani ke istemal

intro.en: A second listening text about how water is used: in farming, sports, industry and homes. Read the statements and think whether each is true.
intro.ur: Doosra matan: pani kin kaamon mein istemal hota hai (kheti, khel, sanat, ghar). Jumle parhiye aur soochiye kaun sa sahi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ ثانٍ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنِ اسْتِعْمالاتِ الماءِ في الزِّراعَةِ وَالرِّياضَةِ وَالصِّناعَةِ وَالبُيوتِ. اقْرَأِ الجُمَلَ وَفَكِّرْ: هَلْ هِيَ صَحيحَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: البُحَيْراتُ وَالأَنْهارُ مَصْرِفٌ لِفَضَلاتِ المَصانِعِ.
dialogue.tr: al-buḥayrātu wa l-anhāru maṣrifun li-faḍalāti l-maṣāniʿ
dialogue.en: Lakes and rivers are a drain for factory waste.
dialogue.ur: Jheelein aur nadiyan karkhanon ke kachre ka nikas hain.

dialogue.ar: يُسْتَعْمَلُ الماءُ لِمُجَرَّدِ الرَّفاهِيَةِ عِنْدَ بَعْضِ النّاسِ.
dialogue.tr: yustaʿmalu l-mā'u li-mujarradi r-rafāhiya ʿinda baʿḍi n-nās
dialogue.en: Water is used for mere luxury by some people.
dialogue.ur: Kuch logon ke yahan pani sirf aish-o-aaram ke liye bhi istemal hota hai.

dialogue.ar: تُسْتَخْدَمُ مِياهُ الأَنْهارِ وَالبِحارِ في أَغْراضٍ غَيْرِ الصِّناعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tustakhdamu miyāhu l-anhāri wa l-biḥāri fī aghrāḍin ghayri ṣ-ṣināʿa
dialogue.en: River and sea water is used for purposes other than industry.
dialogue.ur: Nadiyon aur samundaron ka pani sanat ke ilawa doosre kaamon mein bhi istemal hota hai.

dialogue.ar: بَعْضُ أَنْواعِ الرِّياضَةِ مُرْتَبِطٌ بِالماءِ.
dialogue.tr: baʿḍu anwāʿi r-riyāḍati murtabiṭun bi-l-mā'
dialogue.en: Some kinds of sport are linked to water.
dialogue.ur: Kuch khel pani se jude hote hain.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ مَنازِلُ كَثيرَةٌ لَيْسَ لَها ماءٌ جارٍ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka manāzilu kathīratun laysa lahā mā'un jār
dialogue.en: There are many homes that have no running water.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se gharon mein behta (nal ka) pani nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: تُعْتَبَرُ الأَمْطارُ الَّتي تُسْتَهْلَكُ في الزِّراعَةِ مِنْ ضِمْنِ اسْتِعْمالاتِ الماءِ.
dialogue.tr: tuʿtabaru l-amṭāru llatī tustahlaku fi z-zirāʿa min ḍimni stiʿmālāti l-mā'
dialogue.en: Rain consumed in farming counts among the uses of water.
dialogue.ur: Kheti mein kharch hone wali barish bhi pani ke istemal mein shumar hoti hai.

options_ar: غَرْسُ النَّباتاتِ وَرِعايَتُها لِلْحُصولِ عَلى الطَّعامِ
تَحْويلُ المَوادِّ إِلى سِلَعٍ في المَصانِعِ
مَجارٍ كَبيرَةٌ يَجْري فيها الماءُ العَذْبُ
ماءٌ لا يَأْتي إِلّا مِنَ المَطَرِ

intro.en: Practise reciting the poem of Mālik ibn ar-Rayb at-Tamīmī, in which he mourns himself. Then choose a poem you like, memorize part of it and recite it before classmates.
intro.ur: Malik bin ar-Raib at-Tamimi ka qaseeda (jis mein woh apna marsiya kehte hain) parhne ki mashq. Phir apni pasand ka ek qaseeda chun kar uska hissa yaad kijiye aur sathiyon ke saamne sunaiye.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى قَصيدَةِ مالِكِ بْنِ الرَّيْبِ التَّميميِّ الَّتي يَرْثي فيها نَفْسَهُ. ثُمَّ اخْتَرْ قَصيدَةً تُحِبُّها وَاحْفَظْ جُزْءاً مِنْها وَأَنْشِدْهُ أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ.

dialogue.ar: أَلا لَيْتَ شِعْري هَلْ أَبيتَنَّ لَيْلَةً
dialogue.tr: alā layta shiʿrī hal abītanna layla
dialogue.en: If only I knew whether I will spend a night...
dialogue.ur: Kaash mujhe maloom hota ke kya main ek raat guzaroon...

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْ كُنْتُ عَطّافاً إِذا الخَيْلُ أَحْجَمَتْ
dialogue.tr: fa-qad kuntu ʿaṭṭāfan idhā l-khaylu aḥjamat
dialogue.en: For I was one who charged when the horses held back.
dialogue.ur: Main woh tha jo ghodon ke peechay hatne par bhi hamla karta tha.

dialogue.ar: وَلا تَحْسُداني، بارَكَ اللهُ فيكُما
dialogue.tr: wa lā taḥsudānī, bāraka llāhu fīkumā
dialogue.en: Do not envy me, may Allah bless you both.
dialogue.ur: Mujh par hasad na karna, Allah tum dono mein barkat de.

dialogue.ar: فَلا تَنْسِيا عَهْدي خَليلَيَّ إِنَّني
dialogue.tr: fa-lā tansiyā ʿahdī khalīlayya innanī
dialogue.en: Do not forget my pledge, my two friends.
dialogue.ur: Aye mere do dosto, mera ahd na bhoolna.

options_ar: كَلامٌ مَوْزونٌ مُقَفًّى يَتَأَلَّفُ مِنْ أَبْياتٍ
شِعْرٌ يُقالُ في بُكاءِ الميِّتِ وَذِكْرِ مَحاسِنِهِ

q.en: In this exercise you are asked to:
q.ur: Is mashq mein kya karna hai?
q.ar: ماذا يُطْلَبُ مِنْكَ في هذا التَّمْرينِ؟

options: Memorize part of a poem and recite it
options_ar: أَنْ تَحْفَظَ جُزْءاً مِنْ قَصيدَةٍ وَتُنْشِدَهُ

title.en: Grammar B: Parsing the present verb

intro.en: The present verb is marfūʿ (damma) if nothing comes before it. It is manṣūb after أَنْ، لَنْ، كَيْ and similar particles, and majzūm after لَمْ، لا النّاهِيَة، لامُ الأَمْرِ and conditional words. Example: لَمْ يُغْفِلْ - he did not neglect.
intro.ur: Fel mudari marfoo (damma) hota hai jab uske pehle koi nasib ya jazim na ho. أَنْ، لَنْ، كَيْ ke baad mansoob hota hai, aur لَمْ، لا nahiya, lam-e-amr aur shart ke alfaz ke baad majzoom. Misal: لَمْ يُغْفِلْ - usne ghaflat nahin ki.
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ مَرْفوعٌ بِالضَّمَّةِ إِذا لَمْ يَسْبِقْهُ شَيْءٌ، وَمَنْصوبٌ بَعْدَ أَنْ وَلَنْ وَكَيْ وَنَحْوِها، وَمَجْزومٌ بَعْدَ لَمْ وَلا النّاهِيَةِ وَلامِ الأَمْرِ وَأَدَواتِ الشَّرْطِ. مِثالٌ: «لَمْ يُغْفِلْ».

dialogue.ar: يَفْرَحُ المُؤْمِنونَ بِنَصْرِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: yafraḥu l-mu'minūna bi-naṣri llāh
dialogue.en: The believers rejoice in Allah's help.
dialogue.ur: Momin Allah ki madad par khush hote hain.

dialogue.ar: يُعْجِبُني أَنْ تَقْرَأَ وَتَكْتُبَ دَرْسَكَ في الوَقْتِ المُحَدَّدِ.
dialogue.tr: yuʿjibunī an taqra'a wa taktuba darsaka fi l-waqti l-muḥaddad
dialogue.en: I like that you read and write your lesson at the set time.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pasand hai ke tum apna sabaq muqarrar waqt par parho aur likho.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَخافَ إلّا مِنَ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: lan akhāfa illā mina llāh
dialogue.en: I will not fear anyone but Allah.
dialogue.ur: Main Allah ke siwa kisi se nahin darunga.

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يُغْفِلْ واجِبَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lam yughfil wājibah
dialogue.en: He did not neglect his duty.
dialogue.ur: Usne apna farz nazarandaz nahin kiya.

dialogue.ar: لا تُهْمِلْ دُروسَكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tuhmil durūsak
dialogue.en: Do not neglect your lessons.
dialogue.ur: Apne sabaq ko nazarandaz na karo.

dialogue.ar: إِنْ تَدْرُسْ تَنْجَحْ.
dialogue.tr: in tadrus tanjaḥ
dialogue.en: If you study, you will succeed.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum parho ge to kamyab hoge.

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَسْتَغْفِرِ اللهَ تَجِدْهُ غَفوراً.
dialogue.tr: matā tastaghfiri llāha tajidhu ghafūrā
dialogue.en: Whenever you seek Allah's forgiveness, you find Him Forgiving.
dialogue.ur: Jab bhi tum Allah se maafi maango ge use bakhshne wala paoge.

q.ur: «لَنْ» ke baad fel mudari hota hai:

title.en: Extended reading: The mender of the noble's slips
title.ur: Wasee muta'ala: Kareemon ki laghzishon ko sanwarne wala

intro.en: A story of generosity and gratitude: Khuzayma helps a stranger who is in need, and later this noble man himself falls into hardship. A man known as Jābir ʿatharāt al-kirām comes to the rescue. Read the dialogue in order.
intro.ur: Sakhawat aur ahsan-shanasi ki kahani: Khuzayma ek zaroorat mand ki madad karta hai, phir khud tangi mein aata hai. Tab «Jabir-e-Asrat-ul-Kiram» naami ek aadmi uski madad ko aata hai. Mukaalma tarteeb se parhiye.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ في الكَرَمِ وَالوَفاءِ: يُساعِدُ خُزَيْمَةُ غَريباً مُحْتاجاً، ثُمَّ يُصيبُ هذا الكَريمَ نَفْسَهُ عُسْرٌ، فَيَأْتي لِنَجْدَتِهِ رَجُلٌ يُعْرَفُ بِـ«جابِرِ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ». اقْرَأِ الحِوارَ بِالتَّرْتيبِ.

dialogue.ar: يا هذا، ما جِئْتُكَ في هذِهِ السّاعَةِ، وَأَنا أُريدُ أَنْ تَعْرِفَني.
dialogue.tr: yā hādhā, mā ji'tuka fī hādhihi s-sāʿa, wa anā urīdu an taʿrifanī
dialogue.en: Man, I did not come to you at this hour except wanting you to know me.
dialogue.ur: Aye bhai, main is waqt tumhare paas isi liye aaya ke tum mujhe pehchano.

dialogue.ar: فَما أَقْبَلُهُ أَوْ تُعَرِّفَني مَنْ أَنْتَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-mā aqbaluhu aw tuʿarrifanī man anta
dialogue.en: I will not accept it unless you tell me who you are.
dialogue.ur: Main kuch qabool nahin karunga jab tak tum bata na do ke kaun ho.

dialogue.ar: أَنا جابِرُ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ.
dialogue.tr: anā jābiru ʿatharāti l-kirām
dialogue.en: I am the mender of the noble people's slips.
dialogue.ur: Main kareemon ki laghzishon ko sanwarne wala hoon.

dialogue.ar: زِدْني.
dialogue.tr: zidnī
dialogue.en: Tell me more.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe aur batao.

dialogue.ar: لا مَزيدَ، ثُمَّ مَضى.
dialogue.tr: lā mazīd, thumma maḍā
dialogue.en: No more. Then he left.
dialogue.ur: Is se zyada nahin. Phir woh chala gaya.

dialogue.ar: ابْشِري فَقَدْ أَتى اللهُ بِالفَرَجِ وَالخَيْرِ.
dialogue.tr: abshirī fa-qad atā llāhu bi-l-faraji wa l-khayr
dialogue.en: Rejoice! Allah has brought relief and good.
dialogue.ur: Khush ho jao, Allah ne aasani aur bhalai bhej di.

dialogue.ar: لا سَبيلَ إلى السِّراجِ.
dialogue.tr: lā sabīla ilā s-sirāj
dialogue.en: There is no way to light the lamp.
dialogue.ur: Chiragh jalane ki koi soorat nahin.

dialogue.ar: أُغَيِّرُ مِنْ حالِكَ ما رَثَّ، وَحَيائي مِنِ ابْنَةِ عَمِّكَ أَشَدُّ مِنْ حَيائي مِنْكَ.
dialogue.tr: ughayyiru min ḥālika mā rath, wa ḥayā'ī min ibnati ʿammika ashaddu min ḥayā'ī minka
dialogue.en: I will change what is worn in your condition; my shyness before your cousin is greater than before you.
dialogue.ur: Main tumhari haalat ko theek karunga; mujhe tumhari chachazaad se tum se zyada sharm aati hai.

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ يَنالَني الضُّرُّ مِثْلَ ما نالَكَ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an yanālanī ḍ-ḍurru mithla mā nālak
dialogue.en: I want to be touched by hardship as you were.
dialogue.ur: Main chahta hoon mujhe bhi wohi takleef pahunche jo tumhein pahunchi.

dialogue.ar: يا خُزَيْمَةُ، ما أَبْطَأَكَ عَنّا؟
dialogue.tr: yā Khuzayma, mā abṭa'aka ʿannā
dialogue.en: Khuzayma, what delayed you from us?
dialogue.ur: Aye Khuzayma, tumhein hamare paas aane se kis ne roka?

dialogue.ar: سوءُ الحالِ.
dialogue.tr: sū'u l-ḥāl
dialogue.en: Bad circumstances.
dialogue.ur: Buri haalat.

dialogue.ar: ظَفِرْتُ بِجابِرِ عَثَراتِ الكِرامِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَسُرَّكَ.
dialogue.tr: ẓafirtu bi-jābiri ʿatharāti l-kirām, fa-aḥbabtu an asurrak
dialogue.en: I found the mender of the noble's slips, and I wanted to please you.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe jabir-e-asrat-ul-kiram mil gaya, to maine chaha ke aap ko khush karoon.
